scope: Read-only native analysis for true weight x0.5 on the single low C79 launcher; no game writes or gameplay acceptance.
address_kind: All addresses are RVAs relative to the supported executable module base.

named_weight_path.setter_abi: void __fastcall(void* action_node, float weight): RCX=node, XMM1=weight; stores node+0x7BC then tail-calls weight resolution.
named_weight_path.resolution: 0x720040: nonnegative float node+0x7BC overrides signed i16 current_descriptor.payload+0x28; negative payload weight falls back to uint32 owner.profile(+0xE90)+0xD8.
named_weight_path.propagation: 0x782F30 stores collision+0xB0 and copies it to registered shape-data+0x10 via each shape+0x60.
named_weight_path.restore: Save exact original node+0x7BC, including -1 sentinel; restore via 0x745FA0, letting native current-action/profile resolution recompute effective weight.
named_weight_path.thread: Setter/propagation has no allocation or WinAPI calls but traverses mutable collider arrays without locks. Only invoke on native game-thread callbacks; preserve wrapper/native LastError.

weight_consumers.ownership: 0x7D09F6/0x7D09FA get data from the two native shapes+0x60; 0x7D0A2B..36 orders RBX/R14.
weight_consumers.operation: For shape flags bit24 on both: r=clamp((weightA-weightB+100)/200,0,1). Split contact separation vector by complementary r and (1-r). >=10000 makes that participant immovable. Accumulate vectors in data+0x20..., increment data+0x14 count.
weight_consumers.application: 0x783F7E reads shape+0x60; 0x783F94 calls0x7D24F0 to combine corrections; 0x783FB7..FEC adds corrections to position; 0x783FF1 clears count.

weight_consumers.operation: 0x741C86 compares against float10000 at0x1588B60; >=10000 skips movement through0x741DE6. Below threshold, no proportional weight scaling in this routine. Horizontal/vertical increments are accumulated at movement_state+0x10/+0x14, then vertical velocity clamped.

separate_impulse_path.fields: hit_event+0xE0 combat row; +0xE8 attacker entity; +0x100 victim entity; int32+0x11C impact mode; outputs float+0x138 horizontal,+0x13C vertical,+0x140 angle.
separate_impulse_path.mode: mode==0 is normal impact, not grounded. Native query victim vtable+0x150(condition3) selects grounded vs airborne response.
separate_impulse_path.grounded: 0x71A5DB u8 combat+0x16 horizontal; 0x71A5EE signed i8 combat+0x17 vertical.
separate_impulse_path.airborne: 0x71A56D u8 combat+0x1A horizontal; 0x71A580 signed i8 combat+0x1B vertical; positive values capped at20.
separate_impulse_path.descriptor: This function does not commit a victim action. Its state query and 0x72FB20 direction calculation use the existing action.
separate_impulse_path.do_not_conflate: Changing combat+0x17 from12 to16 is vertical impulse, not weight x0.5. Halving weight is not proved to scale gravity, height or airtime.

existing_action_hook_contract.acquire_before_original: In observed_action(actor,...), owner=*(actor+0x50), component=*(owner+0x230), selected_event=*(component+0x90). Snapshot fields before original_action can clear/free event.
existing_action_hook_contract.selected_event_proof: 0x715EE6/EF7 passes victim_component+0x58 to0x741270. 0x7415E3 stores eligible selected event at damageblock+0x38 => component+0x90.
existing_action_hook_contract.event_constructor: 0x6F9100 copies source combat row to event+0xE0 (0x6F9205), source attack-record+0x28 entity to event+0xE8 (0x6F924B), incoming victim R8 to event+0x100 (0x6F92B2).
match: event+0xE0 == exact ready low-C79 private combat_body address
low import key0xC79, motion5014, adapter_kind2, player_key0xCF5; exclude Mid CB7 Izuna duplicate
commit_order: 0x70ED1B calls0x7119C0; successful action selection writes actor+0x58 at0x711C16 and increments action serial actor+0xDC at0x711D21.
0x70EF93..EFA3 reads NEW descriptor payload and requires uint32(payload+0)&0x40000 (bit18) before selected-hit processing.
0x70F046 calls0x71F3C0(damageblock,...); 0x71F531 loads block+0x38 selected event; 0x71F54A calls0x71A460 with its mode.
0x70F0E4 clears native hit queue through0x721EC0; 0x721F61 nulls block+0x38. Do not dereference saved event after original returns.
0x70F580 refreshes effective native weight after the new action is selected. Apply x0.5 only after original_action returns with a committed bit18 reaction and validated identity.
existing_action_hook_contract.paired_exclusion: Require (uint64(payload+0x18)&0x20000000)==0. Bit29 is the native paired-partner relation gate at0x741418..42F and0x710508..51C. Existing boss_paired compares only two exact imported flag constants; that is too narrow for arbitrary victims.
existing_action_hook_contract.weight_guard: Read current effective collision+B0 after native selection; finite 0<weight<10000. Halve once, never compound on repeat events. Save old override and exact node/owner/collision/vtable/descriptor identity.
existing_action_hook_contract.restoration: Restore before any subsequent setter for tracked victim; restore on observed_frame descriptor exit/disabled session. Skip writes and retire only on positive identity replacement/unmapped memory. Do not carry override into native paired actions.
existing_action_hook_contract.stop: Stop can disable new overrides, but must retain callbacks/ERROR_BUSY until game-thread restoration completes; do not run collider setter on loader/control thread.
existing_action_hook_contract.last_error: Preserve incoming error before native call and native result error afterward around our memory checks/setter calls.

remaining_limits: No runtime implementation or live activation/restoration was tested by this audit.
The hit-queue/bit18 contract proves attribution at action entry; exact low-launch reaction IDs and landing/death variants still require observed gameplay.
Restore-before-any-next-setter is a conservative single-reaction boundary; multi-phase airborne continuation may end the override earlier than landing.
Frame-only first-next-descriptor attribution is not justified: native hit events are cleared/freed during updates and unrelated actions could follow.
Fixed-slot exhaustion, duplicate target hits, Stop while paused, death/unload, native external override changes and owner reuse need owned-memory tests plus gameplay verification.
Weight changes collision response; evidence does not establish a continuous proportional ballistic mass consumer. Preserve separate impulse tuning for requested height.
